RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_collision_type: Sets the collision or attractor shape type for the 3D GPU particles collision or attractor specified by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_cull_mask: Sets the cull mask for the 3D GPU particles collision or attractor specified by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_sphere_radius: Sets the radius for the 3D GPU particles sphere collision or attractor specified by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_box_extents: Sets the extents for the 3D GPU particles collision by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_attractor_streng: Sets the strength for the 3D GPU particles attractor specified by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_attractor_direct: Sets the directionality amount for the 3D GPU particles attractor specified by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_attractor_attenu: Sets the attenuation curve for the 3D GPU particles attractor specified by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_field_texture: Sets the signed distance field texture for the 3D GPU particles collision specified by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_height_field_update: Requests an update for the 3D GPU particle collision heightfield.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_height_field_res: Sets the heightmap resolution for the 3D GPU particles heightfield collision specified by the particles_collision RID.
RenderingServer.particles_collision_set_height_field_mas: Sets the heightfield mask for the 3D GPU particles heightfield collision specified by the particles_collision RID.

RenderingServer.fog_volume_set_material: Sets the Material of the fog volume.
RenderingServer.visibility_notifier_create: Creates a new 3D visibility notifier object and adds it to the RenderingServer.

RenderingServer.visibility_notifier_set_callbacks: Sets the methods to be called when the notifier enters or exits the view.

RenderingServer.camera_set_orthogonal: Sets camera to use orthogonal projection, also known as orthographic projection.
RenderingServer.camera_set_frustum: Sets camera to use frustum projection.
RenderingServer.camera_set_xr_projections: Sets camera to use any set of projections.
RenderingServer.camera_set_cull_mask: Sets the cull mask associated with this camera.
RenderingServer.camera_set_environment: Sets the environment used by this camera.
RenderingServer.camera_set_camera_attributes: Sets the camera_attributes created with camera_attributes_create to the given camera.
RenderingServer.camera_set_compositor: Sets the compositor used by this camera.
RenderingServer.camera_set_use_vertical_aspect: If true, preserves the horizontal aspect ratio which is equivalent to Camera3D.KEEP_WIDTH.

RenderingServer.viewport_set_size: Sets the viewport's width and height in pixels.
RenderingServer.viewport_set_active: If true, sets the viewport active, else sets it inactive.

TextEdit.get_menu: Returns the PopupMenu of this TextEdit.
TextEdit.is_menu_visible: Returns true if the menu is visible.

TextEdit.get_caret_index_edit_order: Returns a list of caret indexes in their edit order, this done from bottom to top.
TextEdit.get_selection_line: Returns the original start line of the selection.
TextEdit.get_selection_column: Returns the original start column of the selection.

TextEdit._cut: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a cut operation.
TextEdit._copy: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a copy operation.

TextEdit..placeholder_text: Text shown when the TextEdit is empty.
TextEdit..editable: If false, existing text cannot be modified and new text cannot be added.
TextEdit..context_menu_enabled: If true, a right-click displays the context menu.
TextEdit..emoji_menu_enabled: If true, "Emoji and Symbols" menu is enabled.

TextEdit..shortcut_keys_enabled: If true, shortcut keys for context menu items are enabled, even if the context menu is disabled.
TextEdit..selecting_enabled: If true, text can be selected.
TextEdit..deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled: If true, the selected text will be deselected when focus is lost.
TextEdit..drag_and_drop_selection_enabled: If true, allow drag and drop of selected text.
TextEdit..middle_mouse_paste_enabled: If false, using middle mouse button to paste clipboard will be disabled.
TextEdit..empty_selection_clipboard_enabled: If true, copying or cutting without a selection is performed on all lines with a caret.
TextEdit..wrap_mode: Sets the line wrapping mode to use.
TextEdit..autowrap_mode: If wrap_mode is set to LINE_WRAPPING_BOUNDARY, sets text wrapping mode.
TextEdit..indent_wrapped_lines: If true, all wrapped lines are indented to the same amount as the unwrapped line.

TextEdit..selection_handle_enabled: If true, enables the handles used for text selection.
TextEdit..virtual_keyboard_enabled: If true, the native virtual keyboard is enabled on platforms that support it.
TextEdit..virtual_keyboard_show_on_focus: If true, the native virtual keyboard is shown on focus events on platforms that support it.
TextEdit..scroll_smooth: Scroll smoothly over the text rather than jumping to the next location.
TextEdit..scroll_v_scroll_speed: Sets the scroll speed with the minimap or when scroll_smooth is enabled.
TextEdit..scroll_past_end_of_file: Allow scrolling past the last line into "virtual" space.
TextEdit..scroll_vertical: If there is a vertical scrollbar, this determines the current vertical scroll value in line numbers, starting at 0 for the top line.
TextEdit..scroll_horizontal: If there is a horizontal scrollbar, this determines the current horizontal scroll value in pixels.

TextEdit..scroll_fit_content_width: If true, TextEdit fits its minimum width to the widest line instead of scrolling horizontally.
TextEdit..minimap_draw: If true, a minimap is shown, providing an outline of your source code.
TextEdit..minimap_width: The width, in pixels, of the minimap.
TextEdit..caret_type: Set the type of caret to draw.
TextEdit..caret_blink: If true, makes the caret blink.
TextEdit..caret_blink_interval: The interval at which the caret blinks (in seconds).
TextEdit..caret_draw_when_editable_disabled: If true, caret will be visible when editable is disabled.
TextEdit..caret_move_on_right_click: If true, a right-click moves the caret at the mouse position before displaying the context menu.
TextEdit..caret_mid_grapheme: Allow moving caret, selecting and removing the individual composite character components.
TextEdit..caret_multiple: If true, multiple carets are allowed.

TextEdit..use_custom_word_separators: If false, using Ctrl + Left or Ctrl + Right (Cmd + Left or Cmd + Right on macOS) bindings will use the behavior of use_default_word_separators.
TextEdit..custom_word_separators: The characters to consider as word delimiters if use_custom_word_separators is true.
TextEdit..highlight_all_occurrences: If true, all occurrences of the selected text will be highlighted.
TextEdit..highlight_current_line: If true, the line containing the cursor is highlighted.
TextEdit..draw_control_chars: If true, control characters are displayed.
TextEdit..draw_tabs: If true, the "tab" character will have a visible representation.
TextEdit..draw_spaces: If true, the "space" character will have a visible representation.
TextEdit..language: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms.
TextEdit..structured_text_bidi_override: Set BiDi algorithm override for the structured text.
TextEdit..structured_text_bidi_override_options: Set additional options for BiDi override.
TextEdit.!text_set: Emitted when clear is called or text is set.
TextEdit.!lines_edited_from: Emitted immediately when the text changes.
TextEdit.!caret_changed: Emitted when any caret changes position.
TextEdit.!gutter_clicked: Emitted when a gutter is clicked.
TextEdit.!gutter_added: Emitted when a gutter is added.
TextEdit.!gutter_removed: Emitted when a gutter is removed.

TextLine..preserve_control: If set to true text will display control characters.

ZIPReader.open: Opens the zip archive at the given path and reads its file index.
ZIPReader.close: Closes the underlying resources used by this instance.
ZIPReader.get_files: Returns the list of names of all files in the loaded archive.
ZIPReader.read_file: Loads the whole content of a file in the loaded zip archive into memory and returns it.
ZIPReader.file_exists: Returns true if the file exists in the loaded zip archive.
ZIPReader.get_compression_level: Returns the compression level of the file in the loaded zip archive.
ZIPReader: Allows reading the content of a ZIP file.
